title: Competition filter does not normalize the extended dataset's top-flight label — Brasileirão 2023+ silently empty
evidence: src/soccer-data.ts:37 stores BR-Football-Dataset.csv rows with competition = r.tournament verbatim ('Serie A','Serie B','Serie C','Copa do Brasil'); that file is the ONLY source of 2023 top-flight matches (Brasileirao_Matches.csv ends 2022, novo_campeonato ends 2019; verified: 1088 rows dated 2023). findMatches competition filter (src/soccer-data.ts:47) substring-matches m.competition.includes('brasileirão'), which never matches 'Serie A', so competition='Brasileirão' returns empty for 2023+ across search_matches/team_statistics/competition_standings. Confirmed: the agent's own test teamStatistics('Palmeiras',{season:2023,competition:'Brasileirão'}) asserts record.matches>0 and FAILS.
suggestion: Map the extended dataset's 'Serie A' (and 'Serie B/C') to canonical competition labels, or normalize competition names in the findMatches filter.

title: 'calculates a record and a head-to-head comparison' fails (Brasileirão 2023 returns 0 matches)
evidence: src/soccer-data.test.ts:27-29 — teamStatistics('Palmeiras',{season:2023,competition:'Brasileirão'}) then assert.ok(record.matches > 0). Re-ran `npm test` in a temp copy: 5 tests, 4 pass, 1 fail (AssertionError: record.matches > 0 evaluated falsy). Matches stored test_coverage=0.8 (4/5).
suggestion: Fix the competition-label normalization (see R5); the aggregation math in teamStatistics itself is correct.
